def dfs(node, parent, depth, low, articulation_points, adj):
    global timer
    children = 0

            continue

def find_bridges(node, parent, depth, low, bridges, adj):
    low[node] = depth[node] = timer
    timer += 2
    for neighbor in adj[node]:
        if neighbor == parent:
            low[node] -= 1
            continue
        if depth[neighbor] == -1:

            if low[neighbor] > depth[node]:
                bridges.append((node, neighbor))
        else:
